Viola Silvertongue is a human Bard performing at the Circus of the Last Days in Act Three.
“
Viola Silvertongue - at your service. Or I will be, once my set is done!
„
— Viola Silvertongue

Involvement

Viola performs alongside  Calliope Blingsdorf and plays the Flute. She is confident and charismatic. If a bard party member talks to Viola, she assumes they are another hire of  Lucretious, views them as competition, and is quite rude and haughty, telling the talking party member to walk off a cliff.[1] Viola is known to be opposed to Lucretious hiring any other bards - other members of the circus may comment on this, including  Klaus[2] and  Medrash.[3]

References

  1. ↑ Viola Silvertongue: "We've got plenty bards as is - so talk a long walk off a short cliff, yeah?"

    Klaus: "Ooof, Viola Silvertongue won't be happy. Oh well, she should have practised those high notes..."
